description: Executable implementation tasks for evidence-based DigitalPulse workflow completion.

tasks.description: Establish a reproducible DigitalPulse baseline and reconcile the product contract with repository evidence.
tasks.reason: Existing documents contain conflicting completion claims; implementation must start from the source tree, current tests, and explicit privacy constraints.
tasks.requirements: Record working-tree state, workspace structure, available scripts, current test/build results, runtime prerequisites, and authoritative Stage 1/Stage 2 scope. Create or update docs/DIGITALPULSE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md, docs/DIGITALPULSE_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER.md, and docs/DIGITALPULSE_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md with evidence-based statuses. Do not overwrite unrelated uncommitted work or claim unavailable runtime verification.

tasks.description: Make authentication, authorization, and tenant boundaries reliable across the real API workflows.
tasks.reason: The project-wide audit marks registration, sessions, role handling, and cross-tenant enforcement as partial or unverified.
tasks.requirements: Inspect and improve login/session lifecycle, role validation, protected routes, organization/site/department/user scoping, and negative cross-tenant access cases. Preserve existing roles and privacy guarantees. Add focused regression tests for unauthorized, expired/invalid, malformed-role, and cross-organization reads and mutations. Keep behavior evidence-based and avoid broad redesign.

tasks.description: Complete the authenticated device, desktop-agent, and browser-extension synchronization workflows.
tasks.reason: Enrollment, heartbeat, offline buffering, idempotency, and loaded-browser behavior are not proven end to end.
tasks.requirements: Verify and improve one-time device enrollment, device secret handling, assignment and revocation, heartbeat freshness, batched activity ingestion, retry/offline queue behavior, duplicate suppression, and browser-extension policy/activity synchronization. Preserve domain-only collection and exclude URL parameters, page content, keystrokes, clipboard data, and screenshots. Add focused tests for replay, revoked devices, malformed batches, restart recovery, and extension/backend contract compatibility.

tasks.description: Wire the dashboard to real API data and complete the highest-value analytics and governance workflows.
tasks.reason: The audit reports mocked or incomplete end-to-end evidence for dashboard, analytics, policies, notifications, audit, and employee/device administration.
tasks.requirements: Inspect API contracts and dashboard fetch/state/error/empty flows for overview, timeline, applications, websites, wellbeing analytics, policies, planner, notifications, audit/privacy, employees, and devices. Replace only stale or fabricated wiring with real API-backed behavior, preserve existing UI functionality, and ensure tenant/user scope is reflected in displayed data. Add focused UI/API tests for loading, empty, error, authorization, policy transitions, notification read/unread, audit visibility, and analytics date/category handling.

tasks.description: Check dependency and runtime security risks introduced or exposed by the integrated workflows.
tasks.reason: Authentication, device credentials, privacy boundaries, and local deployment guardrails are security-sensitive and require explicit evidence.
tasks.requirements: Run the repository's available dependency/security checks, remediate actionable vulnerabilities only when compatible with the current workspace, verify secret/configuration handling, localhost binding, rate limits, audit behavior, and privacy restrictions, and document accepted limitations. Do not introduce cloud credentials or weaken existing protections.

tasks.description: Run focused validation and publish exact implementation evidence and remaining limitations.
tasks.reason: The requested outcome requires a trustworthy report, not unsupported claims of full runtime completion.
tasks.requirements: Run focused contract, backend, dashboard, extension, and Rust tests plus the dashboard build when prerequisites exist. Capture exact commands, pass/fail/skip results, changed files, and unavailable infrastructure. Review startup/package/deployment scripts only where needed for the validated local workflow. Update docs/DIGITALPULSE_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER.md and docs/DIGITALPULSE_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md with final statuses and limitations; distinguish static, unit, integration, browser, database, and Windows runtime evidence.
